title: hours-worked v1
description: One shift, signed by the person who worked it. Apprenticeship hours, volunteering, community service, an internship — anything counted in hours by someone who was not in the room. It is a second profile of the same leaf (see leaf.base.json) and it exists to prove a point: the anchoring layer below it does not know what an hour of work is, any more than it knows what a squat is. Same envelope, same six signals, same monthly attestation.

window.description: The shift. end > start, and end - start <= 16 hours — a single shift, not a week folded into one leaf.

category.description: What the hours count towards. Coarse on purpose: the detail lives in the payload, and the reader who needs it asks the subject.

organisation.description: SHA-256 of the organisation's identifier, salted per issuer. Where someone volunteers can say a great deal about them — a shelter, a clinic, a party. The digest lets a reader confirm 'the same place as last week' without learning which place, and the subject can reveal the preimage when they choose to.

supervised.description: Whether a supervisor was present for the whole window. Distinct from W and N, which say that one signed: someone can be present all day and sign nothing.

$comment: Every base property is re-listed above because `additionalProperties: false` does not see through `$ref` — a known JSON Schema rule, explained in spec/profiles.md. The `allOf` is what makes the base normative; the re-listing is what keeps the profile closed.
